definitions.accepted_acoustic_wake_sessions: Actual kind-2 receive events, checked equal to accepted-wake counter. Not geometric contact intervals; sessions may contain no new DATA.
definitions.aggregation: Arithmetic mean, minimum and maximum of ten run-level counts or sums; ranges are not confidence intervals.
definitions.mission_end_including_recovery_s: Last checked return/offload trajectory end plus declared 600-s external recovery; not deck recovery physics.
definitions.optical_ack_timeout_events: Timeout occurrences before sender confirmation; may repeat per record. These do not identify individual lost ACK packets.
definitions.optical_data_serialization_sum_s: Sum of all attempted optical payload + 69-byte descriptor airtime at 2.5 Mbit/s, including duplicate attempts; excludes propagation, wake/ACK, startup and waiting.
definitions.optical_first_received_records: Unique optical_rx identities: new AUV receiver commitment, not sender ACK. LOW rows are chunks; other rows are individual records.
definitions.optical_received_not_sender_confirmed_at: Unique optically received IDs minus IDs with an actual optical_sender_confirmed event, including preserved received copies whose sender abandons waiting.
definitions.sessions: Optical events uniquely assigned to the matching gateway's accepted wake interval: received wake to request time + declared 30-s listen cap. Not measured continuously usable contact duration.
definitions.surface_complete_low_windows: All required source chunks received via explicit final DATA leg=2/4; timely mature additionally uses oldest sample + 30000 s <= horizon and completion <= deadline.
definitions.surface_vehicle_sender_confirmed_records: Explicit auvSurfaceAcks final-leg aggregate, not per-record ACK identities reconstructed from sinkIndex.

unavailable.geometric_contact_count_and_usable_durat: No complete geometric-contact start/end event stream. Wake sessions and attempted DATA airtime are reported separately.
unavailable.individual_optical_failure_cause: optical_loss combines listen/power/continuous-contact/frame failures; zero recorded DATA losses does not establish every potential contact succeeded.
unavailable.per_record_final_acoustic_ack_identity: ACK events omit leg/token; only explicit final-leg aggregate is used.
unavailable.unattempted_service_gate_failure_breakdo: Range, remaining-window, inactive credit and other pre-transmission exits are not individually traced.
